episodes.en: A house full of little jobs

steps.label: Wonderful dinner, Mii. A head pat!

captions.en: No work today. I'll take care of you.
captions.zh: 今天不要上班，咪养你。

E01-alarm.editNote: New Seedance2.0 picture; original video bitstream untouched. Two spaced alarm notes before hand entry; BGM fades in after switch-off.

captions.en: Oh, right. It's my day off. I forgot the alarm.
captions.zh: 啊对，今天休假。我忘关闹钟啦。

captions.en: Okay. You're on resting duty. I'm on... everything else.
captions.zh: 好，你负责休息。咪负责……其他的。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: One hug. A big one. Then I'll make breakfast.
captions.zh: 先抱一下。抱大一点。然后咪做早饭。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: These go this way. I knew that.
captions.zh: 这只要朝这里。咪本来就知道。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: I tested the jam. With my paw. By accident.
captions.zh: 咪试了下果酱。用爪试的。不是故意的。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Lunch needs shopping. Shopping needs... fancy pants.
captions.zh: 午饭得先买菜。买菜得先……穿条厉害的裤子。

captions.en: Which outfit? I need to look like I know where the eggs are.
captions.zh: 穿哪套呀？咪得看起来像知道鸡蛋在哪儿。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Very grown-up. Still very small.
captions.zh: 很像大人。就是个头还小。

captions.en: We have one egg. That's not a very big lunch. What shall I make?
captions.zh: 只有一个蛋。这个午饭有点小。你想吃什么呀？
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Tomatoes, eggs... and enough sauce for every bite.
captions.zh: 番茄，鸡蛋……每一口都要有酱汁。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Pasta, spinach, cheese. I underlined cheese. Twice.
captions.zh: 意面，菠菜，芝士。芝士咪画了两道线。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Too big. This bottle needs its own car.
captions.zh: 太大啦。这瓶水得自己开一辆车。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: You stay cozy. I'll be back before you miss me. Probably.
captions.zh: 你乖乖休息。想咪之前，咪就回来。应该吧。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Captain Mii. Destination: the egg aisle.
captions.zh: 咪船长。目的地：鸡蛋货架。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: We have one egg. That's not a very big lunch. What shall I make?
captions.zh: 只有一个蛋。这个午饭有点小。你想吃什么呀？

captions.en: Open, please. I asked nicely.
captions.zh: 开一下嘛。咪很有礼貌地问啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: This one's squishy. Not you. You can come.
captions.zh: 这个软啦。不是你。你可以跟咪走。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Beans? You're not on my list. Sorry.
captions.zh: 豆子？你不在名单上。对不起呀。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Strawberries or blueberries? They're both looking at me.
captions.zh: 草莓还是蓝莓？它们都看着咪呢。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Got it. Top floor for you. No squished berries.
captions.zh: 收到。水果住顶楼，不许挤扁。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Got it. Top floor for you. No squished berries.
captions.zh: 收到。水果住顶楼，不许挤扁。
captions.speaker: mii
clerk
captions.en: Need a hand, little shopper?
captions.zh: 小顾客，需要帮忙吗？

captions.speaker: mii
captions.en: That little bag, please. It's my lunch. I'm shopping for two.
captions.zh: 要那小袋。这是咪的午饭。咪今天要养两个人。

captions.speaker: clerk
captions.en: Here you go. What a thoughtful little helper!
captions.zh: 给你。真是个懂事的小帮手！

captions.zh: 咪这么短，收据怎么这么长。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: That's a very long receipt for a very short cat.
captions.zh: 咪这么短，收据怎么这么长。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Delivery! Nothing squished. Not even me.
captions.zh: 送货到啦！没有压扁的。咪也没有。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Chef Mii is ready. The chef is a little nervous.
captions.zh: 咪大厨准备好啦。大厨有一点点紧张。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Rice first. It can cook while I do the clever part.
captions.zh: 先煮饭。它煮着，咪去做聪明的部分。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Oh. Crunchy eggs. I don't think that's a feature.
captions.zh: 哎呀。脆脆蛋。这好像不是优点。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Stay in the pan, please. We almost made it.
captions.zh: 请待在锅里哦。我们就快成功啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Pasta in. Timer on. I am extremely organized.
captions.zh: 意面下锅。计时开始。咪特别有条理。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: The sauce is sticking. Very attached to the pan.
captions.zh: 酱粘住了。它好像特别舍不得这个锅。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Cheese, spinach, pasta. Everybody gets a turn.
captions.zh: 芝士，菠菜，意面。一个一个来，不许挤。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Low heat. Oh. I thought faster heat meant faster lunch.
captions.zh: 小火。哦。咪以为火大一点，午饭就快一点。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Okay. Small steps. Small chef. We match.
captions.zh: 好。一步一步来。小大厨，走小步。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Round two. This time I'm listening to the recipe.
captions.zh: 第二回合。这次咪听菜谱的话。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Lunch is ready! Come see.
captions.zh: 午饭好啦！快来看。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: I made the good version for you.
captions.zh: 成功的那份给你。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Tiny bite.
captions.zh: 小小一口。

captions.en: I blew on it.
captions.zh: 咪吹过了。

captions.en: Twice, just in case.
captions.zh: 怕烫，吹了两遍。

captions.en: Tiny bite. I blew on it. Twice, just in case.
captions.zh: 小小一口。咪吹过了。怕烫，吹了两遍。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: How does it taste?
captions.zh: 味道如何？

captions.en: Really? I mean... yes. Chef Mii knows things now.
captions.zh: 真的？咳……当然啦。咪大厨现在很厉害了。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Wait. Is my hat straight? Okay. Very professional.
captions.zh: 等一下。帽子正吗？好啦。很专业。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Go get cozy. I'll do the dishes. They're only a little taller than me.
captions.zh: 你去舒服地歇着。咪洗碗。碗也就比咪高一点点。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: One drop. Why is there a bubble mountain?
captions.zh: 一滴。怎么长出一座泡泡山呀？
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Oh. The house wants a bath too.
captions.zh: 哦。房子也想洗个澡。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Cleaning outfit. Very serious pockets. No pockets? Still serious.
captions.zh: 打扫的衣服。很严肃的口袋。没口袋？也很严肃。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: A tissue! You nearly became snow. Indoors.
captions.zh: 纸巾！差一点，家里就要下雪啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Another orange cat? Oh. It's my spare fluff.
captions.zh: 还有一只橘猫？哦，是咪掉的备用毛毛。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: A little drink for you. You're still full? Okay.
captions.zh: 你喝一小口。你还饱饱的？那好吧。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Who walked here? Oh. The cleaning lady. That's me.
captions.zh: 谁踩的呀？哦。保洁阿姨。就是咪。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Even this? Okay. Nobody mention this at dinner.
captions.zh: 这个也要呀？好吧。吃晚饭的时候不许提。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Break time. My paws have filed a complaint.
captions.zh: 休息时间。咪的爪爪已经投诉啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: One video. For my very tired brain.
captions.zh: 就看一个。给咪累坏的小脑袋放个假。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: It's research. Look at his little legs. They're so busy!
captions.zh: 这是学习。你看它的小短腿。忙得不得了！
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Again! The tiny wiggle. I need to study that.
captions.zh: 再来一次！扭屁屁那里。咪要重点学习。
captions.speaker: mii

E07-replay.editNote: Existing back-facing establish / motivated over-shoulder screen insert. A waveform unchanged. No new generated performance.

captions.en: One like. From one very impressed cat.
captions.zh: 一个赞。来自一只很佩服你的猫。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Oh! The laundry. I was being very busy... sitting down.
captions.zh: 哦！衣服洗好啦。咪刚才很忙……忙着坐着。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Found your friend. Socks should travel in pairs.
captions.zh: 找到你的朋友啦。袜子要结伴出门。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Want to play? I know one move. It's a really good one.
captions.zh: 玩一局吗？咪会一招。很厉害的一招。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Snack break? You can win fruit. Everybody wins fruit.
captions.zh: 吃点水果吗？奖品是水果。每个人都有水果。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Just fruit, or a little yogurt blanket?
captions.zh: 就吃水果，还是盖一条酸奶小被子？
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Fruit, just as it is. Very good at being fruit.
captions.zh: 就这样。水果当水果，已经很优秀啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: A little blanket.
captions.zh: 盖一点小被子。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Okay...
captions.zh: 好吧……
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: A slightly bigger blanket.
captions.zh: 稍微厚一点。

captions.speaker: mii

captions.zh: 咪只是让眼睛歇一下。它们今天也很努力。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Oh! Dinner time. My eyes had a whole vacation.
captions.zh: 呀，晚饭时间啦。咪的眼睛放了一个大假。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Read first. Cook second. Panic... not on the list.
captions.zh: 先看。再做。慌张……菜谱上没有这一项。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: I saved these for dinner. Past me was very helpful.
captions.zh: 这些是咪给晚饭留的。早上的咪很有远见。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Low heat. I know this button now. We're friends.
captions.zh: 小火。这个按钮咪认识啦。我们现在是朋友。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Table, or the window? I can do room service. Very small room service.
captions.zh: 餐桌还是窗边？咪可以送餐。迷你送餐。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: No surprises in this one. Except how good I got.
captions.zh: 这次没有意外。除了咪变厉害这件事。

captions.zh: 都做完啦。咪只忘了……什么都没忘！等咪看看。嗯！

captions.en: Uniform off. Tiny boss is off duty.
captions.zh: 制服脱掉。小老板下班啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Anything else? Water? A blanket? A smaller blanket... for me?
captions.zh: 还要什么吗？水？被子？小一点的被子……给咪？
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Did I do okay? I tried really hard.
captions.zh: 咪做得好吗？咪很努力啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: You did wonderfully. Now it's my turn to look after you.
captions.zh: 做得特别好。现在轮到我照顾咪啦。

captions.zh: 晚安，我的小宝。

captions.zh: 吃完啦？那轮到咪啦。咪的肚子已经喊了好几遍啦。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!
captions.zh: 石头，剪刀，布——出！
captions.speaker: mii

captions.en: You too? Great paws think alike.
captions.zh: 你也出这个？英雄的爪爪想法一样。
captions.speaker: mii

captions.zh: 石头，剪刀，布——出！
